AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Transform: AWS::Serverless-2016-10-31
Description: Simple Python Lambda function deployed via AWS SAM

Parameters:
  DeploymentBucket:
    Type: String
    Description: S3 bucket name where SAM artifacts will be uploaded (placeholder)
    Default: my-sam-artifacts-bucket

Resources:
  SimpleFunction:
    Type: AWS::Serverless::Function
    Properties:
      FunctionName: SimplePythonFunction
      Runtime: python3.11
      Handler: app.lambda_handler
      CodeUri: src/
      Description: A simple Lambda function written in Python
      MemorySize: 128
      Timeout: 10
      Policies:
        - AWSLambdaBasicExecutionRole
      Environment:
        Variables:
          LOG_LEVEL: INFO

Outputs:
  FunctionArn:
    Description: ARN of the Lambda function
    Value: !GetAtt SimpleFunction.Arn
  DeploymentBucket:
    Description: The S3 bucket used for SAM deployment artifacts
    Value: !Ref DeploymentBucket
